requirements.title: IOSTAT_EOR is assigned for end-of-record without EOF or error and is negative and distinct
requirements.source: S16.10.2.17 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: IOSTAT_EOR is the default integer scalar constant assigned to an IOSTAT= variable for an end-of-record condition during input without end-of-file or error, and its value is negative and different from IOSTAT_END.

pending.iostat-eor-assigned-on-endrecord-no-eof-: Open a scratch sequential formatted file, write record '12', rewind it, initialize status to 777 and size to -777, execute nonadvancing READ(unit,'(A)',ADVANCE='NO',SIZE=size,IOSTAT=status) into a longer character sentinel, and assert status == IOSTAT_EOR; mutate ADVANCE to default advancing input.
pending.iostat-eor-negative: Import IOSTAT_EOR and assert IOSTAT_EOR < 0 with a separate nonadvancing end-of-record read assigning the same named value; mutate the comparison to > 0.
pending.iostat-eor-distinct-from-iostat-end: Import IOSTAT_EOR and IOSTAT_END, assert IOSTAT_EOR /= IOSTAT_END after separately observing end-of-record and end-of-file assignments; mutate the comparison to equality.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans observe only portable single-image properties fixed by 16.10.2: named-constant type/kind/rank, exact relational properties among ISO_FORTRAN_ENV constants and intrinsic inquiries, successful use of preconnected units, or exact IOSTAT named-constant assignment. Processor-dependent numeric values, module extensions, compiler option/version text, team identity, atomic/event behavior, multi-image preconnection, and message text are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Fixture authors must re-derive every pending plan from the pinned source. Existing tests and profiles mention ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, CHARACTER_KINDS, INTEGER_KINDS, COMPILER_VERSION text in a test name, and unrelated INT8-style identifiers; this packet records that coverage without rebinding it. The numeric IOSTAT_EOR value beyond negativity and distinctness from IOSTAT_END is not asserted.
